panels.title: Active problems - what cannot keep up right now (rules: monitoring/alerts.scale.yml)
Critical
panels.description: Rules in the critical state: something is lost or about to be.

panels.title: Warnings
panels.description: A component is falling behind another (drops, full queues, no headroom).

panels.title: Pending
panels.description: Conditions that are true but have not lasted long enough to fire yet.

panels.title: Detections lost/min
panels.description: Detection metadata really lost (the meta-only safety queue overflowed). Should always be 0.

panels.title: Previews shed/min
panels.description: Annotated preview frames skipped because the publisher is behind; their detections are still published.

panels.title: GPU throttles (30 min)
panels.description: Times a throttle reason started; each one is in events.log with power limit, AC and temperatures.

panels.title: Late frames/min (QoS)
panels.description: GStreamer elements dropping frames as too late.

panels.title: Firing now
panels.description: One row per firing rule (per camera / container where it applies).

panels.title: Overview - is anything about to break?
Cameras alive
panels.description: Cameras the sidecar published a frame for in the last 30 s (of 15).

panels.title: Worst camera silence
panels.description: Seconds since the quietest camera was last seen by the pipeline.

panels.title: NVDEC (decoders)
panels.description: Hardware video decoders. At 100 % frames start to be dropped.

panels.title: GPU throttled
panels.description: The GPU is slowing itself down (power cap, heat, hardware slowdown).

panels.title: VLM backlog
panels.description: Association questions waiting for the VLM.

panels.title: VLM slowest answer
panels.description: Slowest of the last 20 VLM calls.

panels.title: Platform feed backlog
panels.description: Batches waiting for the truck-tracking platform to read them.

panels.title: Core / decoder / encoder %
panels.description: NVDEC is the binding resource for many 1080p/4K streams: it saturates before the core does.

panels.title: Power draw vs power limit (W)
panels.description: A laptop GPU's limit moves (power is shared with the CPU); a throttle starts when draw meets the limit.

panels.title: Held back by policy (s per min)
panels.description: NVML violation status: seconds of every minute the GPU ran below its best clock because of a policy.

panels.title: Clocks (SM vs max) - falls when throttled
Per camera
panels.description: input alive: the footage/camera feed reaches go2rtc.  silent for: time since the pipeline last published this camera.  restarts: source restarts by the stall watchdog.

panels.title: Analysis rate per camera (fps)
panels.description: Frames per second that got through inference. A dead source reads 0.

panels.title: Can't keep up - drops, waits, backlogs per component
Previews shed/s per camera
panels.description: A shed preview skips drawing/encoding only; its detections are still published. 'DETECTIONS LOST' must stay 0.

panels.title: Publisher queue wait per camera (ms)
panels.description: How long the oldest recent job waited for its drawing worker; rising = the worker cannot keep up.

panels.title: go2rtc -> sidecar bitrate per camera (Mbit/s)
panels.description: During a source stall this keeps flowing while the camera's frames stop: the sidecar, not the stream, is stuck.

panels.title: Source stalls
panels.description: [source-stall] START/END lines in events.log carry the evidence (queue levels, decoder-thread census).

targets.legendFormat: decoder threads in a sleep loop

panels.title: Analysis queues vs their cap
panels.description: All lines on the cap = decoders are blocked waiting for the GPU/probe stage (no headroom).

panels.title: GStreamer late-frame drops/min
panels.description: QoS = an element dropped a frame as too late.

panels.title: GPU stage busy %
panels.description: Share of wall time each GPU element is busy (probe-measured).

panels.title: Analysis queue fill (buffers)
panels.description: A queue pinned at its maximum is where back-pressure starts: the mux/decoder is falling behind.

panels.title: Seconds since last VLM answer
panels.description: -1 = none yet. Large while association work exists means the VLM is stuck.

panels.title: Platform (truck-tracking) and the camera system app
Feed backlog and age of last push
Feed events, 5 min (by status)
panels.description: rejected / failed should stay 0.

panels.title: Stall forensics - what the sidecar was doing when cameras went quiet
Main loop lag
panels.description: How long the sidecar's GLib main loop has not turned (the watchdog, bus handling and source restarts all run on it). Red = the loop is blocked; the stack of every thread is then written to data/flight/stall-*.txt.

panels.title: Scheduling delay
panels.description: How late a plain watcher thread wakes from a 2 s sleep: CPU or GIL starvation shows here first.

panels.title: Sidecar CPU
panels.description: 100 = one core; this machine has 16 threads.

panels.title: Publisher drops/min
panels.description: Annotated frames dropped because the publisher threads cannot keep up (CPU drawing).

panels.title: Bus events per minute (all cameras)
panels.description: nodata = 'No data from source since last 10 s'; writefail = 'Could not write to resource' (the reconnect that never recovers); error/warn = everything else on the bus.

panels.title: Sidecar warnings and errors (Loki)
panels.description: The same time range as the graphs. Stall dumps are announced here with the blocked call.

panels.title: Disk free %
panels.description: data = the camera system's data dir; footage = the recordings drive.

panels.title: Exporter polls (1 = ok)
panels.description: A source at 0 means that part of this dashboard is blind.
